div.p: M&T BANK + RDC.AI

div.class: et_pb_text_4 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_dark et_pb_module et_block_module preset--module--divi-text--default

div.h3: M&T Bank leverages RDC.AI to anticipate risks, and strengthen the foundation for growth in commercial banking
div.p: Peter D'Arcy, M&T's Head of Commercial Banking outlines the benefits of partnering with RDC.AI to transform how the bank operates. The bank has automated risk detection leveraging richer, real-time data, so that bankers gain deeper insights and can have meaningful conversations with clients.

div.class: et_pb_text_6 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_dark et_pb_module et_block_module preset--module--divi-text--default

div.h3: How Westpac is reshaping business lending with RDC.AI

p.span: Tamara Bryden from Westpac shares how partnering with RDC.AI is accelerating loan decisions, surfacing risk earlier, and giving bankers clearer insights for better customer conversations — powered by real-time data and explainable AI.

p.span:
Accelerate Time to Value.

p.span:

Explainable AI for Monitoring, Confidence and Insights

div.p: Proven Solutions

div.class: et_pb_text_13 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module preset--module--divi-text--default

p.span:
RDC.AI Solutions demonstrate a proven track record of seeing initiatives go live faster, for a fraction of the cost.
They provide our clients with templates and blueprints as well as pre-defined implementation processes that de-risk outcomes.

div.class: et_pb_column_16 et_pb_column et_flex_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et_flex_column_8_24 et_flex_column_8_24_tablet et_flex_column_24_24_phone

div.p: Proactively identifies customers showing early signs of credit risk deterioration using continuous surveillance.
Proactively identifies customers showing early signs of credit risk deterioration using continuous surveillance.

div.div: From After the fact alerting of high risk behaviors
To Proactive indication that business may be experiencing cashflow stress

div.class: et_pb_column_17 et_pb_column et_flex_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et_flex_column_8_24 et_flex_column_8_24_tablet et_flex_column_24_24_phone

div.p: Streamlines the review process for lending portfolios by automating manual assessments and surfacing the insights that matter.
Streamlines the review process for lending portfolios by automating manual assessments and surfacing the insights that matter.

div.div: From One size fits all reviews that are schedule driven.
To More efficient reviews that consider the customers risk and cashflow health.

div.class: et_pb_column_18 et_pb_column et-last-child et_flex_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et_flex_column_8_24 et_flex_column_8_24_tablet et_flex_column_24_24_phone

div.p: Uses AI to analyze cash flow, seasonality, and repayment data to surface new lending opportunities within an existing portfolio.
Uses AI to analyze cash flow, seasonality, and repayment data to surface new lending opportunities within an existing portfolio.

div.div: From Rushed, elongated and often chaotic process to extend credit
To A pre-approved limit providing faster time to funding with greater confidence and less manual intervention

div.class: et_pb_column_19 et_pb_column et_flex_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et_flex_column_8_24 et_flex_column_8_24_tablet et_flex_column_24_24_phone

div.p: Leveraging Merchant Transactions to support lending, includes pre-assessment, origination, and monitoring.
Leveraging Merchant Transactions to support lending

div.div: From Fixed terms or expensive overdrafts that do not take into account a business cashflow
To Flexible lending based on daily takings. We use a cashflow-driven model to accurately predict when a customer will pay out the loan

div.class: et_pb_column_20 et_pb_column et-last-child et_flex_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et_flex_column_16_24 et_flex_column_16_24_tablet et_flex_column_24_24_phone

div.p: Portfolio level aggregations accompanied by a powerful AI Assistant designed to support portfolio governance as well as ad-hoc investigation.
Portfolio Alerts
Portfolio Navigator
Portfolio Assistant

div.div: From After the fact alerting of high risk behaviours
To Proactive indication that business may be experiencing cashflow stress
From Manual monitoring with delayed risk identification and after-the-fact reviews
To Automated early warning signals with 6-month forward visibility into credit risk
From Manual review process requiring significant banker time and effort
To Fully automated credit reviews with AI-driven recommendations at scale
Portfolio Alerts

div.class: et_pb_column_21 et_pb_column et_flex_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et_flex_column_8_24 et_flex_column_8_24_tablet et_flex_column_24_24_phone

div.p: Accelerate the assessment of facilities to simplify / automate their review and rollover.
Accelerate the assessment of facilities to simplify / automate their review and rollover.

div.div: From Bankers and customers trudging through renewals despite no material changes.
To Flexible lending based on daily takings. We use a cashflow-driven model to accurately predict when a customer will pay out the loan.

div.class: et_pb_column_22 et_pb_column et_flex_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et_flex_column_8_24 et_flex_column_8_24_tablet et_flex_column_24_24_phone

div.p: Supporting the implementation and monitoring of Risk Rating models
Supporting the implementation and monitoring of Risk Rating models

div.div: From Fragmented model lifecycles leading to increased risk, cost, and solution complexity.
To Unified RDC.AI platform for compliant model monitoring and stateful, distributed results.

div.class: et_pb_column_23 et_pb_column et-last-child et_flex_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et_flex_column_8_24 et_flex_column_8_24_tablet et_flex_column_24_24_phone

div.p: Leveraging the platform we use for our solutions, you can accelerate the delivery of your own
Leveraging the same platform we use for our solutions, you can now accelerate the delivery of your own

div.div: From Designing and assembling multiple technologies to operationalise analytics and AI initiates.
To A single compliant platform for model and data driven credit innovation.
